metadata.source: User supplied BVE 東北本線 / Map4129M.txt (E531 4129M northbound scenario)
metadata.direction: 黒磯 → 新白河 (source chainage increases in the same direction)
metadata.chainageCalibration: Piecewise affine mapping through all six BVE station anchors to requested RailLab station distances.
metadata.gradesSchema: Hold the current perMille until next s when interpolationToNext=constant; linearly interpolate to next perMille when linear. Positive means uphill northbound.
metadata.elevationsSchema: Relative height in meters with Kuroiso=0, integrated over calibrated simulator distances; elevations sampled every 10m. Use grades for exact analytic integration.
metadata.speedPolicy: Use baseline board values: evaluate $SpeedLimit=0 for 701, preserve E531 source configured +10 values as sourceConfiguredKmh. Effective kmh is min(110, baseline); SpeedLimit.End resets to 701 vehicle cap 110.
limitations: BVE source is a community-authored scenario, not authoritative surveyed present-day infrastructure.
No independent 701-series curve allowance profile was supplied; E531 +10 allowance is deliberately not used.
Signal-aspect speed limits and train-specific ATS/ATC braking patterns are excluded from permanent track limits.
At source13910 Gradient.BeginTransition and Begin(-1) occur at the same chainage; retained as an instantaneous change.
At source11690 and11700 duplicate BeginTransition commands occur before Begin(9.7)11760; prior gradient is held through11700.
Grades retain the source numerical per-mille values while positions are distance-calibrated. The integrated height differs from integrating original BVE chainage.
Source speed entries are distance-sorted, preserving file order for identical chainages; overlapping source13100 Begin115 supersedes prior Begin(95+$SpeedLimit), and duplicate End13355 is collapsed.
